title: Six Strange Structures Were Found Above Earth's Core
mediaSource: Earth core mantle boundary deep learning seismic structures 2026

scenes.title: Strange structures were found 2,900 kilometers below us
scenes.narration: Scientists used seismic waves and deep learning to identify six unusual regions near the boundary between Earth's mantle and core.

scenes.title: We cannot go there, so scientists read earthquakes
scenes.narration: The core-mantle boundary lies about 2,900 kilometers underground, far beyond direct observation, so researchers study how seismic waves travel through it.

scenes.title: Deep learning searched decades of seismic data
scenes.narration: The team analyzed roughly three decades of seismic records with deep learning to find subtle signals that are difficult to identify manually.

scenes.title: Six unusual regions stood out
scenes.narration: The analysis revealed six areas near the core-mantle boundary that may differ from surrounding material in density or composition.

scenes.title: Earth's interior may be far more complicated
scenes.narration: The structures could be linked to mantle flow, ancient pieces of crust, or chemical differences preserved deep inside the planet.

scenes.title: The world beneath our feet is still largely unknown
scenes.narration: We can photograph distant galaxies, but we have never directly seen Earth's deepest layers. Seismic waves are slowly drawing that hidden map.
